item.title: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026: iPhone 17 at ₹79,999; iPhone Air at ₹99,900 — check offers
item.description: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 began on October 28, offering discounts on Apple iPhones, laptops, wearables and home appliances. The iPhone 17 is available at an effective price of ₹79,999, while the iPhone 15 is listed at ₹59,999 with eligible offers.

item.title: Karbonn Rebel 5G teased on Amazon: How the Indian brand eyes comeback with affordable smartphones for Gen Z
item.description: Karbonn is making a comeback in India’s smartphone market, targeting Gen Z and content creators with affordable devices amid rising smartphone prices. The homegrown brand has teased the Rebel 5G on Amazon, but its specifications, pricing and launch date remain unconfirmed.

item.title: AI-led services to generate up to USD 200 billion in new work by 2030: BCG report
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI)-led services are expected to generate between USD 100 billion and USD 200 billion in net new work by 2030, with technology services companies able to meet most of the demand by reskilling their existing employees, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG).

item.title: Why is Apple charging ₹6 lakh extra for 16TB storage on its new touchscreen MacBook Pro?
item.description: Apple’s new touchscreen MacBook Pro costs up to $14,549 (approximately ₹13.87 lakh), with the 16TB SSD upgrade alone adding $7,000 (around ₹6.67 lakh).

item.title: Microsoft Visual Studio update brings smarter Copilot AI, bulk conflict resolution and Hot Exit: Details here
item.description: Microsoft has updated Visual Studio with improved Git tools, including commit comparisons and bulk merge-conflict resolution. The release also adds a new GitHub Copilot Chat experience, Hot Exit for restoring unsaved work, and other new features.

item.title: Delhi Liquor Booking app launched: How to order online and 48-hour collection rule explained
item.description: Delhi has launched the Delhi Liquor Booking app ahead of Diwali, allowing eligible customers to book liquor online from 208 DSIIDC-operated outlets across the city.

item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.2 adds Siri AI memory, five new beta languages, CarPlay and FaceTime changes, and 160+ security fixes. See what’s new and why to update.

item.title: Indian IT firms poised to benefit from enterprise AI adoption as infrastructure costs rise: Report
item.description: Indian information technology (IT) companies are well-positioned to benefit from the growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by enterprises, as rising infrastructure investments and funding requirements increase financial risks for companies building and operating AI computing capacity, according to a research report by Anand Rathi.

item.title: Apple iMac M6 price in India revealed: Features, pre-order date and sale details
item.description: Apple has launched the M6-powered iMac in India at a starting price of ₹1,74,900, with claims of up to five times faster on-device AI performance than the M4 model. The new desktop features a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and macOS 27, and comes in seven colour options.

item.title: Free Fire India launches on 28 October: Diwali event, download details and new safety features
item.description: Garena is launching Free Fire India today, with free downloads planned on the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store. The India-specific version will feature a Diwali event running until 15 November, along with local content and support for a wide range of smartphones.

item.title: Nearly 60% of firms yet to move AI beyond pilots as deployment remains key challenge: Report
item.description: Nearly 60 per cent of organisations surveyed remain in the exploration or pilot stages of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, with only around 40 per cent having moved to production or scaling, highlighting the challenge businesses face in deploying AI across their operations, according to a report by Citi Institute.

item.title: AI token use may jump 78% as falling prices fail to guarantee lower costs: Accenture
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) costs may not fall in line with declining token prices as consumption is expected to surge by 78 per cent over the next two years, potentially offsetting savings for businesses, according to an Accenture Research report.

item.title: Agentic AI could strengthen financial-crime prevention, but governance, cost hurdles limit adoption: McKinsey
item.description: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) could reduce the time banks spend on know-your-customer (KYC) processes by 30 to 70 per cent, improving efficiency in financial-crime prevention, but high human oversight costs and challenges related to governance and accuracy continue to hinder its wider adoption, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

item.title: Facing screen-breaking issues on iPhone Duo? Apple says ‘We are aware ’ — What users can do now
item.description: Apple has acknowledged an inner-display issue affecting a small number of iPhone Duo units after users reported cracks along the fold within hours or days of use. The company has advised affected customers to contact AppleCare for a replacement.

item.title: Free Fire India launch date 2026: Is Garena releasing the game soon? What we know
item.description: Garena has not confirmed a launch date for Free Fire India, despite renewed speculation following changes to its Indian YouTube channels and creator updates suggesting a possible October 28, 2026 release.&nbsp;

item.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple brain wearable: ₹85,000 price, pre-order date and features
item.description: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple brain-monitoring wearable is reportedly priced at ₹85,000, including a lifetime subscription, with pre-orders opening on November 1, 2026. The device tracks changes in cerebral blood flow and generates an Entropy score to indicate physiological strain.

item.description: Tech companies are utilising job cuts to demonstrate a commitment to margin expansion, pushing stock prices higher even as they announce internal restructuring.

item.title: Less than 20 folds, one cracked screen: iPhone Duo buyers raise durability concerns
item.description: Apple iPhone Duo buyers have reported cracked inner screens near the hinge within hours of use, with one user claiming the display broke after fewer than 20 folds. Images shared on Reddit reportedly show similar damage across multiple devices, raising concerns about the foldable phone’s durability.

item.title: Oppo ColorOS 17 beta update rolls out early to OnePlus 15, Find X9 series: New features and AI upgrades and more
item.description: Oppo has begun rolling out ColorOS 17 ahead of schedule to the OnePlus 15 and Find X9 series. The Android 17-based update brings redesigned animations, AI tools, performance improvements and new security features.

item.title: OnePlus Diwali Sale 2026: Nord 6, OnePlus 15, Nord CE6 Lite get discounts; check offers on phones, earbuds and tablets
item.description: OnePlus Diwali Sale 2026 offers discounts on smartphones, tablets and audio products. The OnePlus Nord 6 starts at ₹42,999 and OnePlus 15 at ₹81,999 with bank offers. Smartphone deals run until October 25, while tablet and audio offers end on October 27.

item.description: Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has set October 23, 2028, as the target for India to develop its own smartphones with domestic design, manufacturing and intellectual property.&nbsp;

item.title: Ever heard of a touchscreen garment? World's 1st is here - washable, breathable; it responds to finger presses, wireless
item.description: NUS researchers have developed a washable touchscreen sleeve that displays photos and videos, responds to touch, and measures body temperature. Made from electronic fibres, it retained its brightness and touch response after 50 machine washes.
